biological_description: DNA repair enzyme abundance (indirect proxy; does not measure DNA damage burden)
Telomere replication/maintenance machinery (does not measure telomere length)
Chromatin-modifying and remodeling enzymes (does not measure epigenetic state/methylation)
ER/proteostatic stress-response proteins (elevation can reflect stress induction or adaptive capacity)
Core autophagy machinery abundance (does not measure autophagic flux)
Respiratory chain & TCA enzyme relative abundance (requires normalization & respirometry for capacity)
Transcript-derived meta-analysis of genes underexpressed with age (prior, not proteomic clock)
Senescence-associated cell-cycle & chromatin regulators (does not establish irreversible arrest)
Intracellular junction/signaling proteins (cannot assess systemic intercellular communication)
Cell-autonomous inflammatory proteins in lysate (secreted SASP/cytokines largely unmeasured)
Host innate immune/TLR signaling (explicitly NOT a dysbiosis measurement; dysbiosis unmeasurable in HepG2)
Transcript-derived meta-analysis of genes overexpressed with age (prior, not proteomic clock)
